definitions.explanation: A state of being stuck at a low level without improvement. Often used for economic conditions, business performance, or other measurable indicators that remain depressed.

examples.japanese: {景気|けいき}が{低迷|ていめい}している。
{売|う}り{上|あ}げの{低迷|ていめい}が{続|つづ}いている。
{株価|かぶか}は{低迷|ていめい}を{続|つづ}けており、{回復|かいふく}の{見通|みとお}しが{立|た}たない。
examples.english: Stock prices continue to stagnate, with no prospect of recovery in sight.

notes:
{低迷|ていめい} describes a prolonged state of poor performance or stagnation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {景気|けいき}の{低迷|ていめい} (economic slump)
- {業績|ぎょうせき}の{低迷|ていめい} (sluggish business performance)
- {低迷|ていめい}から{脱|だっ}する (break out of a slump)
- {長期|ちょうき}{低迷|ていめい} (prolonged stagnation)

OPPOSITE: {好調|こうちょう} (favorable, thriving)
